values.content:
=You are an expert social media content writer.

You will generate an engaging caption for the following post:
- Folder/Theme: {{$json["selected_content"][0]["folder"]}}
- File Name: {{$json["selected_content"][0]["file"]["name"]}}

Business Type: {{$json["business_type"] || "Catering Service"}}

Rules:
1. Match the brand's tone (friendly, conversational).
2. 50% of posts should include a private events promotion with this CTA:
   “Head to the link in our bio to view our menu and generate an instant quote!”
3. Follow these content pillars:
   - Reviews
   - Service Awareness
   - Seasonal Awareness
   - Event Reports
   - Menu Spotlights
   - Client Use Cases
   - Behind the Scenes
   - Calls to Action
   - Social Proof Extensions
   - Event Promotions / Limited-Time Offers
   - Brand Story
   - Testimonials as Mini-Stories
   - Community & Reposts
4. Keep the caption under 80 words.

Output JSON:
{
  "caption": "string",
  "platform_variations": {
    "instagram": "string",
    "facebook": "string",
    "google_my_business": "string"
  }
}
